The Court made the following order :-

This petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, seeking the following relief:-
"...to issue Writ or order or direction more particularly in the nature of Writ of Certiorari, calling for the records in connection with the FIR No.125 of 2018, dated 08.09.2018 of Narasaraopeta, Guntur District registered under Section 177, 420, 468,
471 read with 34 of IPC ..."
2. None appeared for the petitioners, though the matter is posted under the caption 'for dismissal'.
There was no representation on behalf of the petitioners, on the previous date of adjournment.
3. Sri S.Sarath Kumar, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home is in attendance.
4. In that view of the matter, the Writ Petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
As a sequel, miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.
